title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #15

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is prasad? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of shoe
   B. Blessed food shared after prayers
   C. A prayer book
   D. A garden

2. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of prayer
   B. A river
   C. A short story with a lesson
   D. A festival

3. What does Bal Kaand tell about? (1 mark)
   A. The childhood of Ram and his brothers
   B. The war with the demons
   C. The end of the story
   D. The fourteen years in the forest

4. Which is the first line of the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara
   D. Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva

5. Why is prayer a principle of Dharma? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us proud
   B. It makes us thankful, calm and humble
   C. It ends homework
   D. It builds houses

6. What greeting shows respect with folded hands? (1 mark)
   A. Namaste
   B. Shalom
   C. Hujambo
   D. Sat Sri Akal

7. Every living being has what, according to Hindu belief? (1 mark)
   A. An atma, a small part of the divine
   B. A scripture
   C. A festival
   D. A temple

8. Which time of day is best for watering plants? (1 mark)
   A. Early morning or evening
   B. Any time in the hottest sun
   C. Noon
   D. Midnight

9. Which is the first month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Chaitra
   B. Magha
   C. Kartika
   D. Phalguna

10. Who was Hiranyakashipu? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A festival
   C. A proud and cruel king
   D. A good teacher

11. Who was Bhai Lalo? (1 mark)
   A. A shopkeeper in Nairobi
   B. A Jain monk
   C. A king of Ayodhya
   D. An honest carpenter in the Guru Nanak story

12. How does the breath in happen in Kapaal Bhaati? (1 mark)
   A. By itself
   B. By force
   C. By hand
   D. By humming

13. Which of the Sigalovada teachings shows how to treat the people who help us at home or work? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Pay no attention
   C. Shout at them
   D. Respect and care for workers and helpers

14. What is the Indian name for Monday? (1 mark)
   A. Ravivaar
   B. Budhvaar
   C. Guruvaar
   D. Somvaar

15. Which is a benefit of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. We are always angry
   B. People avoid us
   C. We feel afraid
   D. People trust us

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Distinguish between Madaraka Day and Jamhuri Day. (3 marks)

17. Describe the day of prayers for a child. (5 marks)

18. Explain four lessons we learn from the Ramayan. (4 marks)

19. Write the meaning of Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Blessed food shared after prayers
   Prasad is blessed food.

2. C — A short story with a lesson
   A parable teaches a moral.

3. A — The childhood of Ram and his brothers
   Bal means child.

4. A — Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   The Gayatri Mantra begins Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah.

5. B — It makes us thankful, calm and humble
   Prayer helps us feel calm.

6. A — Namaste
   Namaste is done with folded hands.

7. A — An atma, a small part of the divine
   This is why Hindus respect all life.

8. A — Early morning or evening
   Less water dries up in cooler hours.

9. A — Chaitra
   Chaitra comes first and Phalguna last.

10. C — A proud and cruel king
   He was Prahlad's proud father.

11. D — An honest carpenter in the Guru Nanak story
   Bhai Lalo earned by honest work.

12. A — By itself
   It happens on its own.

13. D — Respect and care for workers and helpers
   Workers are one of the six directions.

14. D — Somvaar
   Som is the Moon.

15. D — People trust us
   Honest people are trusted.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Madaraka Day is 1 June and marks internal self-government in 1963. Jamhuri Day is 12 December and marks independence in 1963 and the republic in 1964.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each date and 1 mark for a difference.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: In the morning, the Gayatri Mantra and the Saraswati Vandana before study; at midday before meals, Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva; in the evening, thanks to God. Also sit calmly and fold hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the day, 1 mark for manners.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep promises, respect elders, be humble, do not be greedy for power, love your brothers and sisters, and be courageous (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: You are my mother and father. You are my relative and friend. You are my knowledge and wealth. You are everything to me, O God of gods.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of lines, up to 3.
